request.description:
Retrieves all blog posts from the API.

**Method:** GET  
**Endpoint:** `/api/posts`

Sends a GET request to the `/api/posts` endpoint and returns a list (array) of all available blog posts. No request body, authentication, or additional headers are required.

## Get Single Post

Retrieves a single blog post by its unique identifier.

**Endpoint:** `GET /api/posts/:id`

### Path Parameter

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | integer | Yes | The unique ID of the blog post to retrieve (e.g., `2`) |

### Successful Response

On success, the endpoint returns a `200 OK` status along with a JSON object representing the requested blog post. The response typically includes details such as the post ID, title, content, author, and timestamps.

### Example Request

```
GET http://127.0.0.1:5003/api/posts/2

request.description:
Creates a new blog post by submitting the post details as query parameters to the API.

**Endpoint:** `POST /api/posts/add-post`

**Query Parameters:**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `title` | string | Yes | The title of the blog post. |
| `subtitle` | string | No | A short subtitle or tagline for the post. |
| `body` | string | Yes | The main content/body text of the blog post. |
| `author` | string | Yes | The name of the post's author. |
| `img_url` | string | No | A URL pointing to the cover image for the post. |

**Notes:**
- All parameters are passed as query parameters (not in the request body).
- A successful request creates the post and returns a confirmation response.

request.description:
## Edit/Update A Post

Partially updates an existing blog post by its ID. Only the fields you include in the request will be updated — all other fields remain unchanged.

**Method:** `PATCH`
**URL:** `http://127.0.0.1:5003/api/posts/:id`

Replace `:id` in the URL with the numeric ID of the post you want to update (e.g. `/api/posts/3`).

---

### Query Parameters

All query parameters are optional. Include only the ones you want to update.

| Parameter | Description |
|-----------|-------------|
| `title` | The new title for the post |
| `subtitle` | The new subtitle for the post |
| `body` | The new body/content of the post |
| `author` | The author of the post |
| `img_url` | The image URL for the post |

---

### Example

To update only the title and subtitle of post #3:

```
PATCH http://127.0.0.1:5003/api/posts/3?title=The Essential Role of Urban Trees&subtitle=Why cities need more trees than ever
```

# Delete A Post

Deletes an existing blog post from the system by its unique post ID. Once deleted, the post is permanently removed and cannot be recovered.

---

## Request Details

| Property | Value |
|----------|-------|
| **Method** | `DELETE` |
| **URL** | `http://127.0.0.1:5003/api/posts/delete-post/:id` |

---

## Path Parameter

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | integer |  Yes | The unique identifier of the post to delete. Example: `2` |

---

## Query Parameter

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `api_key` | string | ✅ Yes | Your secret API key used for authentication. Must be included with every request. |

---

## Expected Response

On success, the server returns a confirmation that the specified post has been deleted.

- **Status Code:** `200 OK`
- **Behavior:** The post matching the provided `id` is permanently deleted from the database.

---

## Example Request

```
DELETE http://127.0.0.1:5003/api/posts/delete-post/2?api_key=YourSecretAPI
```
